transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because if I think there might be a bat, or hear something flapping around the stockroom, I panic right away. My heart starts racing, I sweat, and I just feel like I have to get out of there immediately.
Do you ever experience these panic symptoms suddenly out of nowhere, without any trigger or thought of bats?
No. It happens when I think there could be a bat, or when I hear that flapping sound in the stockroom. Then it hits me right away.
Did this intense fear start after a specific traumatic or life-threatening incident involving a bat?
Yeah. It started about two years ago, when a bat got into the back corridor during a receiving shift.
Do you experience recurrent, unwanted memories of that incident popping into your head?
No, not really. I don’t have memories of it just popping into my head on their own.
